purpose: Small general explanation corpus; never patient-specific diagnosis or treatment. Wording is original short paraphrase, links credit the authoritative source. No third-party images/full article copied.

entries.title: What HbA1c measures
entries.text: HbA1c is a blood test reflecting average blood glucose over approximately the previous two to three months.
entries.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine, MedlinePlus
entries.scope: general definition only; not diagnostic thresholds or patient interpretation

entries.title: Reading a report reference range
entries.text: A reference range is a comparison range printed by the laboratory. Ranges can differ by laboratory method and patient group. A result outside or within that range is not, by itself, a complete assessment of health.
entries.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine, MedlinePlus
entries.scope: Use the range on the actual patient source; never substitute this corpus for it.

entries.title: Results need context
entries.text: Clinicians interpret laboratory findings alongside health history, examination and other relevant information. A laboratory result alone may not explain a person’s condition.
entries.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine, MedlinePlus
entries.scope: general explanation only; no diagnosis, medicine or follow-up advice
